name: Gladys Cromwell
bio: Gladys Cromwell (1885–1919) was an American poet, born in New York City, who with her twin sister served with the Red Cross in France during the First World War.
Her poems were collected in The Gates of Utterance (1915) and in a volume published after her death in 1919.

poems.title: The Crowning Gift
poems.author: Gladys Cromwell

poems.title: The Mould
poems.author: Gladys Cromwell
poems.text:
No doubt this active will,
So bravely steeped in sun,
This will has vanquished Death
And foiled oblivion.

But this indifferent clay,
This fine, experienced hand
So quiet, and these thoughts
That all unfinished stand,

Feel death as though it were
A shadowy caress;
And win and wear a frail
Archaic wistfulness.
